mnemonic.meaning: A machine's (機) structure (構). A mechanism, an organization.
mnemonic.reading: KEY, COKE (きこう): the Coke company's key mechanism. Same sound as 気候 (climate).

examples.ja: 政府は新しい機構を作った。
examples.en: The government set up a new body.

items.note: Formal: organizations (国際機構) or mechanisms.

mnemonic.meaning: Operate (操) the controls (縦). Piloting, steering.
mnemonic.reading: SO JUICY (そうじゅう): the pilot steers with one hand and eats a so-juicy burger with the other.

examples.ja: 父は飛行機を操縦する仕事をしている。
examples.en: My father's job is flying airplanes.

items.note: For planes, ships, machines; also manipulating people. 運転 is for cars.

mnemonic.meaning: Turf (芝) that's alive (生). A lawn.
mnemonic.reading: SHIBA, FOO (しばふ): the shiba dog rolls on the lawn.

examples.ja: 芝生に入らないでください。
examples.en: Keep off the grass.

items.note: 芝 alone is turf.

mnemonic.meaning: Container (器) that contains (容). A vessel.
mnemonic.reading: YO, KEY (ようき): "Yo, the key is in that container."

examples.ja: 残った料理を容器に入れた。
examples.en: I put the leftovers in a container.

items.note: 入れ物 is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: Go up (上) and reach (達) a higher level. Improvement in a skill.
mnemonic.reading: JOE, TAT, SUE (じょうたつ): Joe's tattoo skills improve. Sue is impressed.

examples.ja: 毎日練習して、ピアノが上達した。
examples.en: I practised every day and got better at piano.

items.note: Only for skills. 上手になる is close.

mnemonic.meaning: 煮 has 灬 (fire) at the bottom: cooking over fire. To simmer, to boil.
mnemonic.reading: KNEE, RUE (にる): you boil your knee by accident and rue it.

examples.ja: 野菜を弱火で煮た。
examples.en: I simmered the vegetables over low heat.

items.note: Cooking in liquid. 茹でる (Level 21) is boiling in water. 煮える = to be cooked.

mnemonic.meaning: Make (作) it by the method (法). Manners, etiquette.
mnemonic.reading: SAW, HO (さほう): "Saw, ho!" No sawing at the table. Etiquette!

examples.ja: 茶道の作法を習った。
examples.en: I learned tea ceremony etiquette.

items.note: Formal or traditional manners. 礼儀 (Level 13) is politeness in general.

mnemonic.meaning: 芽 has 艹 (plant) on top: a new plant appears. A sprout.
mnemonic.reading: MEh (め): a sprout pops up like a little eye (目).

examples.ja: 春になって木に芽が出た。
examples.en: Spring came and the trees put out buds.

items.note: 芽が出る = to sprout. Also figurative: 才能の芽.

mnemonic.meaning: 生 is grow: let it grow. To grow a beard.
mnemonic.reading: HA, YA, SUE (はやす): "Ha, yah, Sue, you're growing a beard?"

examples.ja: 彼はひげを生やしている。
examples.en: He has a beard.

items.note: For hair, beards, weeds. Intransitive: 生える (to grow).

mnemonic.meaning: Wash (洒) and look stylish. Fashionable, dressing up.
mnemonic.reading: OH, SHA, RAY (おしゃれ): "Oh, Shah Ray, you're so stylish!"

examples.ja: 彼女はいつもお洒落だ。
examples.en: She's always stylish.

items.note: Usually in kana: おしゃれ.

mnemonic.meaning: Something the soil (土) produces (産) where you travelled. A souvenir.
mnemonic.reading: ME, YA, GAY (みやげ): "Me, yeah, I got a souvenir!"

examples.ja: 旅行のお土産を買った。
examples.en: I bought souvenirs on my trip.

items.note: Usually お土産. In Japan you bring them back for coworkers.

mnemonic.meaning: 鼠 looks like a mouse with whiskers and tail.
mnemonic.reading: NEZUMI (ねずみ): "NAY, ZOO, ME!" The mouse refuses to go to the zoo.

examples.ja: 台所に鼠が出た。
examples.en: A mouse appeared in the kitchen.

items.note: Usually written ネズミ or ねずみ.

mnemonic.meaning: Rescue (救) and help (助). A rescue.
mnemonic.reading: CUE, JOE (きゅうじょ): on cue, Joe rescues the cat.

examples.ja: 山で遭難した人が救助された。
examples.en: The people lost on the mountain were rescued.

items.note: Emergencies. 助ける is everyday. 人命救助 = lifesaving.

mnemonic.meaning: Money that branches (支) out (出). Expenses.
mnemonic.reading: SHE, SHOE, TSU (ししゅつ): her biggest expense is shoes.

examples.ja: 今月は支出が収入より多かった。
examples.en: This month my expenses were higher than my income.

items.note: Opposite: 収入 (しゅうにゅう, income). Formal; 出費 (しゅっぴ) is close.

mnemonic.meaning: The reason (訳) you humbly say (申し). An excuse, an apology.
mnemonic.reading: MOE, SHE WACKY (もうしわけ): Moe says she's sorry for being wacky.

examples.ja: 申し訳ありません。
examples.en: I'm very sorry.

items.note: Mostly in 申し訳ない / ございません, a polite apology.

mnemonic.meaning: 切 is cut: a cut piece, a slice.
mnemonic.reading: KEY, RAY (きれ): Ray cuts a slice of cake.

examples.ja: ケーキを一切れください。
examples.en: A slice of cake, please.

items.note: Counter: 一切れ (ひときれ). Also 期限切れ (expired).

mnemonic.meaning: Withdraw (退) from study (学). Leaving school.
mnemonic.reading: TIE, GACK (たいがく): he throws his school tie and quits. GACK!

examples.ja: 彼は大学を退学した。
examples.en: He dropped out of university.

items.note: Leaving before graduating. 退学処分 = expulsion.

mnemonic.meaning: 都 is capital: the old capital, Kyoto.
mnemonic.reading: ME, YA, COKE (みやこ): "Me, yeah, I drink Coke in the capital!"

examples.ja: 京都は千年以上、日本の都だった。
examples.en: Kyoto was Japan's capital for over a thousand years.

items.note: Literary. Read と in 東京都, つ in 都合.

mnemonic.meaning: 連 is take along: someone you take along. A companion.
mnemonic.reading: TSU, RAY (つれ): Ray is your companion.

examples.ja: 連れが来るまで待っています。
examples.en: I'm waiting for my companion.

items.note: 子連れ = with a child.

mnemonic.meaning: Stay overnight (泊) at the inn (宿). Lodging.
mnemonic.reading: SHOE, COO, HACK (しゅくはく): at the hotel, your shoe hacks the pigeon.

examples.ja: ホテルに三日間宿泊した。
examples.en: I stayed at the hotel for three days.

items.note: Formal. 泊まる is everyday. 宿泊料 = room charge.

mnemonic.meaning: Proper (正) rules (規). Official, regular.
mnemonic.reading: SAY, KEY (せいき): "Say, here's the official key."

examples.ja: 彼は正規の社員として採用された。
examples.en: He was hired as a regular full-time employee.

items.note: 正規雇用 = regular employment. 非正規 = non-regular.

mnemonic.meaning: A house (家) of pictures (画). A painter.
mnemonic.reading: GAH, CAR (がか): "Gah!" The painter paints a car.

examples.ja: ゴッホは有名な画家だ。
examples.en: Van Gogh is a famous painter.

items.note: 〜家 = an expert or professional: 作家 (writer), 音楽家.

mnemonic.meaning: 膜 has 月 (flesh): a thin layer of flesh. A membrane, a film.
mnemonic.reading: MACK (まく): Mack peels the thin film off the yogurt.

examples.ja: 牛乳を温めると表面に膜ができる。
examples.en: When you heat milk, a skin forms on top.

items.note: 鼓膜 = eardrum.

mnemonic.meaning: 刑 has 刂 (knife): punishment by knife. A sentence.
mnemonic.reading: KAY (けい): Kay gets a harsh sentence.

examples.ja: 彼は三年の刑を受けた。
examples.en: He was sentenced to three years.

items.note: Legal term. 死刑 = death penalty, 刑務所 = prison.

mnemonic.meaning: The period (期) beforehand (予). Expectation.
mnemonic.reading: YO, KEY (よき): "Yo, I expected you to have the key."

examples.ja: 予期しない出来事が起きた。
examples.en: Something unexpected happened.

items.note: Mostly in 予期せぬ / 予期しない (unexpected).

mnemonic.meaning: 党 is a party, a faction.
mnemonic.reading: TOE (とう): the political party's leader stubs his toe.

examples.ja: 彼は新しい党を作った。
examples.en: He formed a new party.

items.note: 政党 = political party. 野党 = opposition, 与党 = ruling party.

mnemonic.meaning: Knowing (知) ability (能). Intelligence.
mnemonic.reading: CHEE, NO (ちのう): the cheese has no intelligence.

examples.ja: 人工知能の研究が進んでいる。
examples.en: Research into artificial intelligence is advancing.

items.note: 人工知能 = AI. 知能指数 = IQ.

mnemonic.meaning: Decide (決) to go (行) anyway. Going ahead despite rain.
mnemonic.reading: KECK, KOH (けっこう): "Keck, go!" The game goes ahead despite the rain. Same sound as 結構.

examples.ja: 雨でも試合を決行します。
examples.en: The match will go ahead even if it rains.

items.note: Doing something as planned despite bad conditions. 雨天決行 = rain or shine.

mnemonic.meaning: 宅 has 宀 (roof): under the roof. A house, home.
mnemonic.reading: TACO (たく): you eat tacos at home.

examples.ja: 先生のお宅にお邪魔した。
examples.en: I visited my teacher's home.

items.note: Mostly お宅 (someone's home, polite) and in compounds: 自宅, 帰宅 (Level 1).

mnemonic.meaning: 墨 is 黒 (black) + 土 (earth): black earth. Ink.
mnemonic.reading: SUE, ME (すみ): Sue gets ink all over me.

examples.ja: 筆に墨をつけて字を書いた。
examples.en: I dipped the brush in ink and wrote characters.

items.note: Ink used in calligraphy (書道).
